skill.name: generating-ai-actors
skill.description: Generates a photorealistic fictional adult as a reusable identity reference for consistent images and videos.
skill.summary: Creates a distinct fictional AI actor with defined appearance, wardrobe, setting, and camera framing.
skill.author: supercmohq

content.user_title: Create a Reusable Photorealistic AI Actor
content.value_statement: Campaigns need a consistent fictional person without arranging a photo shoot. This skill defines and generates one reusable adult identity for later visual assets.
actual_capabilities: Defines an adult actor through specific facial features, build, hair, clothing, and distinguishing details.
Creates a fictional identity designed for reuse as a visual reference in later generations.
Selects a detailed setting, background, colors, weather, time, and natural lighting.
Builds a casual phone-camera composition with direct eye contact and realistic skin texture.
Generates one image with a default model and aspect ratio when the user provides no preference.
Handles pending jobs and common generation rejections with controlled retry guidance.
limitations: Generates one still image, not a complete video or multi-image campaign.
Cannot guarantee perfect identity consistency across every downstream image or video model.
Creates fictional adults only and does not reproduce real people or public figures.
Requires a configured image provider and may need prompt changes when safety filters reject a request.

use_cases.title: Cast a Campaign Spokesperson
use_cases.description: Create a fictional adult presenter whose identity can recur across advertisements and social posts.

use_cases.title: Design a Virtual Creator
use_cases.description: Define a distinctive influencer with recognizable features, wardrobe, and an authentic everyday setting.

use_cases.title: Prepare Visual Talent
use_cases.description: Generate a reusable actor reference before producing storyboards, product scenes, or video assets.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic AI Actor
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a fictional adult AI actor for [purpose]. Choose a distinctive appearance and place them in a natural setting.
prompt_templates.scenario: Start with a simple actor brief.

prompt_templates.title: Cast a Brand Presenter
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an adult presenter for [brand category]. Match [audience traits] and [brand tone]. Use practical clothing and an appropriate everyday location.
prompt_templates.scenario: Align a spokesperson with a target audience.

prompt_templates.title: Define a Distinct Identity
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a fictional adult with [age range], [build], and [style]. Specify facial structure, eyes, hair, skin texture, wardrobe, and one distinguishing feature.
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a recognizable reference for repeated use.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Production Reference
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a reusable adult actor for [campaign]. Define identity, wardrobe, environment, daylight, and phone-camera framing. Prioritize continuity across [future asset types].
prompt_templates.scenario: Prepare an advanced reference for a multi-asset campaign.

output_examples.input: Create an AI presenter for a sustainable skincare brand aimed at urban professionals.
output_examples.output: A photorealistic fictional adult presenter in practical modern clothing, photographed at arm's length in a bright city apartment.

output_examples.input: Cast a mature virtual creator for a home coffee campaign.
output_examples.output: A distinctive fictional adult with detailed facial features, natural skin texture, casual clothing, and a lived-in kitchen background.

output_examples.input: Generate a reusable fitness spokesperson with a friendly and credible appearance.
output_examples.output: A fictional athletic adult in covered training clothes, using direct eye contact and neutral daylight in an everyday outdoor setting.

best_practices: Provide the campaign purpose, target audience, and any required demographic or wardrobe details.
Describe distinctive facial features precisely so the generated image offers a stronger identity reference.
Reuse the finished image as the identity reference for later image or video generation.
anti_patterns: Do not request a real person, public figure, or recognizable likeness.
Do not rerun a generation while its job status remains pending.
Do not expect this skill to produce a complete video, campaign, or multiple actor variations.

faq.question: Does this skill create real people?
faq.answer: No. It creates fictional, non-identifiable adults that should not resemble real people or public figures.

faq.question: Can I reuse the same actor?
faq.answer: Yes. Use the generated image as a visual reference in later image or video requests.

faq.question: Does it generate videos?
faq.answer: No. It produces one still image that can support a separate video workflow.

faq.question: Can I specify appearance and clothing?
faq.answer: Yes. User requirements override defaults, provided the actor remains an adult and the request passes provider safety rules.

faq.question: What happens when generation is pending?
faq.answer: The workflow checks the existing job until completion instead of starting another billed generation.

faq.question: What happens when an image is rejected?
faq.answer: The workflow adjusts the blocked element, tries a supported alternative, and stops after repeated rejection.
